body:
## Maintainer report — 2026-10-11

> Something odd is going on with the browser remote control from the phone. When the cursor is over a clickable element, it turns into a hand and isn’t clickable instead of it remaining a cursor and clicking the element. This may have to do with our user agent being a tablet (iirc), which could create issues, but the cause could be something else.

## Initially observed behavior — before implementation

The owner identifies Dropbox’s first screen and authorized one screenshot. The reviewed720×480 frame shows the handheld pointer as a hand over Continue with Google. Whether failure affects every control or only identity-provider buttons, and separate-tap behavior, are still being clarified. A hand cursor alone is a normal link affordance; the reported failure to activate the element is the issue. The tablet user agent is an owner hypothesis, not an established cause. Do not change it without comparing actual input/event behavior.

The existing phone control is implemented in `projects/ROCKNIX/packages/network/rclone/sources/cloud_oauth`: touch/mouse pad handlers, click endpoint and a real uinput pointer. The browser is `projects/ROCKNIX/packages/network/cloud-signin-window/sources/cloud-signin-window.c`. Trace pointer motion, button down/up, focus and provider event/UA handling together; retain keyboard/scroll/Back/Cancel behavior. Current deployed firmware is8b5113fa16 with ES1d76b3da7d unless the actual readback proves otherwise.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Use an isolated installed guest and credential-free local page containing links, buttons and text inputs; exercise the actual phone-control HTTP/event path and browser, recording received events and navigation. Compare a provider-specific route only after the page is identified and with an authorized QA fixture. Actual phone-browser touch dispatch is a named physical/client fact if it cannot be reproduced synthetically. The later explicit screenshot permission was consumed once through tools/device-act (rc0, unchanged boot id). No input, browser restart or sign-in submission is authorized.

## Read-only evidence and source trace

The installed cloud_oauth hash matches current source. The browser log contains three refused navigations to login.microsoftonline.com; only aggregate counts/public hostnames were retained. The browser's user-gesture/cross-host guard is therefore a concrete blocker for this identity transition. It does not establish a universal click failure. Preserve navigation confinement while supporting intended authentication transitions; do not simply allow arbitrary external hosts.

No explicit tablet user-agent override exists in the current browser source; tablet_pad refers to controller classification. Actual runtime UA is unmeasured. Phone taps use a motion threshold and a60ms delay with separate movement/command queues; ordering under latency was a separate unproved hypothesis at initial triage. The implementation and VM results below supersede that initial status.

Evidence: docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-cloud-owner-feedback/. Owner image stays local, with reviewed description/hash only in the committed packet. Already written: current firmware's sign-in window can silently refuse user-initiated external authentication navigation; no credentials, cloud files or device configuration were changed by this investigation. Any fix must preserve working configurations and cancel/exit behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] The exact page, client/control surface and interaction that fails are recorded; source trace identifies actual user-agent configuration and pointer/click routing without assuming either caused the failure.
- [x] A credential-free VM reproduction records pointer hover plus down/up/click events and actual link/button activation, distinguishing the normal hand cursor from lost input/focus. Original failure and backend/browser logs are retained with exact source/image binding.
- [x] A confirmed fix has an old-source negative control and passing link/button/input/drag/scroll/keyboard/back/cancel cases; otherwise retain the precise unresolved assertion rather than declaring a cause or changing the UA speculatively.
- [x] Any player-facing or input-flow change updates canonical flow/menu references and reviewed exact-source happy/branch screenshots, EN/FR where text changes, with syntax/package checks before pin promotion. Physical verification requires its named action and device-facts row if needed.

Parent #344; triage before the next candidate freeze. This new report follows completed #532/#533 reconciliation; #528 still owns source/component decisions. No new firmware or device operation is launched by filing it.

## Current implementation and qualification — 2026-10-11 07:12 UTC

The isolated source now uses one ordered/coalesced phone-input queue and allows the exact Dropbox authentication hosts with related WebKit popup support. #539 also fixes the advertised Back action. No user-agent change was made. The delayed-input old-source negative control fails; the corrected queue controls pass. Actual target WebKit proof records 16 passing event/navigation controls, including provider-handled/modified keys, typing/deletion, scrolling, popup return, blocked unrelated navigation and Close. The original owner report is not generalized into a claim about every Dropbox control.

Source/binary/event evidence: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-network-cloud-management/browser/`. Canonical menu/flow/changelog are updated in the feature worktree. The reviewed frame table and schema1 evidence index are now delivered in the local feature packet and linked from the canonical references. The scoped independent review under #344 still precedes integration; the new sanitized Fable transfer is awaiting named approval. No new image, owner-device action or live-account login occurred. Acceptance checkboxes remain open until final delivery proof is attached.

## Verified source delivery — 2026-10-11T16:27:55.227775+00:00

Distribution [bc2dceb406](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/commit/bc2dceb406969a401d987de168acfb3ae60b7e01) and ES [c8dc72cf9e](https://github.com/pixelelated/emulationstation/commit/c8dc72cf9ec00ab00d6c4a9fcdcea1746c6f1f78) are integrated and pushed. Final delivery head `849e8dd3126a43f53abcae2678622c75ef85a08f` has successful exact-head hosted record and private-word checks. [Canonical flow/evidence packet](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/849e8dd3126a43f53abcae2678622c75ef85a08f/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-network-cloud-management); [independent audit, all seven repairs and Phase7 resolution](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/849e8dd3126a43f53abcae2678622c75ef85a08f/docs/audits/2026_10_11-epic-m7-network-cloud-344).

AC1: retained owner report and sanitized host-policy trace distinguish normal hand cursor from refused navigation; no speculative UA change. AC2–3: old-source delayed-input failure plus 16 actual WebKit input/navigation controls, source/binary/event receipts, reviewed browser frames. AC4: canonical menu/flow/changelog and schema1 index are published; package build and syntax pass. Real provider authentication is outside the synthetic input-mechanics claim; public guide follow-up remains #511.

Only owned VM/local synthetic endpoints were used. The source fix is delivered; no new firmware image, owner-device update or personal-cloud action is claimed. Combined-image release qualification remains under #344/#537.
